# Comprehensive Research Report: Apple Premium Resellers & Authorised Resellers in India (MacBook Pro Deals, Clearance & Student Offers)

### Executive Summary
This research evaluates all major Apple Premium Resellers (APRs), Apple Premium Partners (APPs), and Apple Authorised Resellers (AARs) in India with active online storefronts. The evaluation focuses on:
1. **Deals, Offers, or Clearance sections**
2. **Student/Education pricing pages & Back-to-School programs**
3. **MacBook Pro models on discount and pricing (in INR)**
4. **Reseller status and verification requirements**

---

| Reseller / Store | Type / Region | Website URL | Deals / Clearance Section? | Student / Education Page? | Back-to-School / Student Offer? | MacBook Pro Pricing / Discounts |

| **Aptronix** | Apple Premium Partner (Pan-India) | [aptronixindia.com](https://www.aptronixindia.com) | **Yes** (Offers page & bank cashbacks) | **Yes** ("Back to Cool" portal) | **Yes** (Up to 8-10% off Mac + accessories + AppleCare) | 14" MBP: ₹2,20,708 (MRP ₹2,39,900) + ₹15,000 bank cashback |
| **Imagine (Tresor Systems)** | Apple Premium Partner (North/West) | [myimaginestore.com](https://www.myimaginestore.com) | **Yes** (Promotional Offers) | **Yes** (Dedicated Student Offer) | **Yes** (~7% edu discount + bank cashback) | 14" MBP: Net effective ₹2,08,107 (MRP ₹2,39,900); 16" MBP: ₹3,19,707 |
| **Imagine (Ample Technologies)** | Apple Premium Partner (South/Online) | [imagineonline.store](https://www.imagineonline.store) | **Yes** (Offers & Timeless Tech Sale) | **Yes** (Student & Teacher Discounts) | **Yes** (Edu rates + bank cashback + EMI) | 14" & 16" MBP configurations with edu pricing + up to ₹15,000 cashback |
| **Unicorn Store** | Apple Premium Partner (North/West) | [shop.unicornstore.in](https://shop.unicornstore.in) | **Yes** (**"Hot Deals"** clearance up to 35% off) | **Yes** ("Built for Students") | **Yes** (Student pricing + Cashify trade-in bonus) | 14" & 16" MBP: 6% direct off + bank cashback; Clearance units 25–35% off |
| **iPlanet** | Apple Premium Partner (South India) | [iplanet.one](https://iplanet.one) | **Yes** (Seasonal sales & clearance) | **Yes** (Student/Teacher Discounts) | **Yes** (Documented edu savings + exchange bonus) | MBP 14" & 16": Instant cashback up to ₹15,000 + ₹10,000 trade-in bonus |
| **iVenus** | Apple Premium Partner (Gujarat/Maha) | [ivenus.in](https://ivenus.in) | **Yes** (Hot Deals & Open Box) | **Yes** (Student Offers) | **Yes** (Class 9+ & college edu discounts) | MBP 14"/16": ~3%+ base edu discount + bank cashback + Open Box clearance |
| **FutureWorld** | Apple Premium Reseller (Pan-India) | [futureworldindia.in](https://www.futureworldindia.in) | **Yes** (Offers tab) | **Yes** (Student Corner) | **Yes** (Student pricing via helpline/portal) | MBP 14"/16": Bank cashback up to ₹15,000 (ICICI/SBI/Axis) + exchange bonus |
| **iNvent** | Apple Premium Partner (North/NCR/Blr) | [inventstore.in](https://www.inventstore.in) | **Yes** (Offers page) | **Yes** (Student Enquiry Form) | **Yes** (8% to 22% student discount campaigns) | MBP: Up to 22% off during student campaigns + ₹10,000 card cashback |
| **iTech** | Apple Premium Reseller (East India) | [itechstore.co.in](https://itechstore.co.in) | **Yes** (Offers & Demo units) | **Yes** (5-step Student Portal) | **Yes** (3% to 15% discount on select Macs) | Select MBP configurations discounted; clearance/demo models based on pincode |
| **iCrest** | Apple Authorised Reseller (North/East) | [icreststore.in](https://icreststore.in) | **Yes** (Seasonal & End-of-Season sales) | **Yes** (Apple Student Discount page) | **Yes** (Downloadable consent form + doc upload) | MBP models eligible for student discount + instant cashback + Loan Mela EMI |
| **IndiaiStore** | Official Distributor Platform (Redington/Ingram) | [indiaistore.com](https://www.indiaistore.com) | **Yes** (Aggregated APR Offers & Calculator) | **Yes** (Central Back-to-School Hub) | **Yes** (National cashback schemes for APRs) | Up to ₹10,000–₹15,000 instant card cashback across 3,000+ reseller stores |
| **Maple Store** | Apple Reseller / ASP (Mumbai/Maha) | [maplestore.in](https://maplestore.in) | **Yes** (Focus on **Certified Pre-Owned**) | **No** (Online store focused on pre-owned) | **No** (No new-device student portal online) | Certified Pre-owned MacBook Pros with 32-step inspection & limited warranty |
| **Reliance Digital** | National Apple Authorised Reseller | [reliancedigital.in](https://www.reliancedigital.in) | **Yes** (Offers & Bank Discounts) | **No** (General student guide only) | **No** (No dedicated student ID portal) | MBP 14"/16": Instant cashback ₹5,000–₹15,000 + 6-month NCEMI |
| **Croma** | National Apple Authorised Reseller | [croma.com](https://www.croma.com) | **Yes** (Offers tab on product page) | **No** (Included in general promotions) | **No** (No separate student portal) | Instant card discounts (HDFC/ICICI/Axis) + No-Cost EMI |
| **Vijay Sales** | National Apple Authorised Reseller | [vijaysales.com](https://www.vijaysales.com) | **Yes** (Apple Days Sale) | **No** (Seasonal creator/student sales) | **No** (No verification portal) | Promotional price cuts during Apple Days + bank cashback + easy EMI |
| **Apple India Official Education** | Direct Apple Store Online (*Benchmark*) | [apple.com/in/shop/education](https://www.apple.com/in-edu/shop) | **Yes** (Back to School Promotion) | **Yes** (UNiDAYS Verification) | **Yes** (Free AirPods/accessories + edu discount) | MacBook Pro: Up to ₹12,900 educational savings + free AirPods bundle |

---

### Detailed Reseller Breakdowns

#### 1. Aptronix (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [aptronixindia.com](https://www.aptronixindia.com)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Offers promotional deals and bank offers on its product pages. Cancellation terms formally specify conditions for "sale, clearance, or promotional offer" items.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Features the **"Back to Cool"** student program at [portal.aptronixindia.com/student-form](https://portal.aptronixindia.com/student-form).
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:**
    *   Flat 8% to 10% discount on MacBooks.
    *   15% off third-party accessories and 5% off Apple accessories.
    *   25% off Protect+ with AppleCare services.
    *   Lifestyle and education vouchers worth up to ₹40,000.
    *   Verification requires College ID and Aadhaar card.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:**
    *   14-inch MacBook Pro: Listed at ₹2,20,708 (MRP ₹2,39,900; flat 8% store discount) + up to ₹15,000 instant cashback on select bank cards (bringing net effective cost to ~₹2,05,708).

#### 2. Imagine Store – Tresor Systems (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [myimaginestore.com](https://www.myimaginestore.com)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Active promotional and student offers section.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated page at [myimaginestore.com/student-offer](https://www.myimaginestore.com/student-offer).
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Flat ~7% education discount on Mac models for verified students/teachers, stackable with partner bank cashback (Axis, ICICI, SBI). Verification via downloadable student consent form.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:**
    *   14-inch MacBook Pro: MRP ₹2,39,900; Net Effective Price ₹2,08,107 (after 7% student discount + card cashback).
    *   14-inch MacBook Pro (Higher Specs / Max): MRP ₹4,99,900; Offer Price ₹4,74,905 (~5% discount).
    *   16-inch MacBook Pro: MRP ₹3,59,900; Net Effective Price ₹3,19,707.

#### 3. Imagine Online – Ample Technologies (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [imagineonline.store](https://www.imagineonline.store)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Offers section hosting recurring promotional events such as the "Timeless Tech Sale" and seasonal campaigns.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated "Student and Teacher Discounts" portal.
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Tailored education pricing on eligible Mac configurations with college ID verification, combined with No-Cost EMI and bank cashbacks.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:** Up to ₹15,000 instant cashback on select bank credit cards + store education pricing on 14" and 16" MacBook Pro models.

#### 4. Unicorn Store (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [shop.unicornstore.in](https://shop.unicornstore.in) / [unicornstore.in](https://unicornstore.in)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** **Yes – dedicated "Hot Deals" / "UNi DealHot" section**. This is one of the few APR stores with an explicit clearance section selling brand-new/sealed previous-generation MacBooks at steep discounts.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Features a "Student Offer" / "Built for Students" portal.
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Student discounts stackable with bank card cashback and Cashify trade-in bonuses.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:**
    *   Current MacBook Pro 14" & 16" models: ~6% instant store discount + bank cashback (Axis, ICICI, SBI, HDFC).
    *   Hot Deals Clearance: Older/previous-generation MacBook Pro models discounted between **25% to 35% off original MRP**.

#### 5. iPlanet (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [iplanet.one](https://iplanet.one)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Offers & Deals section with festival/seasonal campaigns and exchange programs.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated Student & Teacher Discounts page.
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Requires valid Student ID / Teacher ID and supporting government ID. Offers base education discounts + trade-in bonuses.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:**
    *   Up to ₹15,000 instant bank cashback on select MacBook Pro models.
    *   Exchange bonus of up to ₹10,000 via Cashify.
    *   Partner reward accruals (such as IndiGo BluChips).

#### 6. iVenus (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [ivenus.in](https://ivenus.in)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Yes. Features "Hot Deals" and an **"Open Box"** section for discounted previous-generation devices.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. "Student Offers" section.
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Open to high school students (Class 9+), college students, and faculty members upon ID submission.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:** ~3%+ student discount + instant cashback with Axis/ICICI/SBI cards + trade-in bonus.

#### 7. FutureWorld India (Apple Premium Reseller)
*   **Website:** [futureworldindia.in](https://www.futureworldindia.in)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Yes, product-level offer listings and affordability options.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated **"Student Corner"** at [futureworldindia.in/student-corner](https://www.futureworldindia.in/student-corner).
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Special pricing and bundled offers available upon student credential verification.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:** Instant cashback up to ₹15,000 (ICICI, SBI, Axis), Cashify trade-in bonus, and No-Cost EMI plans.

#### 8. iNvent Store (Apple Premium Partner)
*   **Website:** [inventstore.in](https://www.inventstore.in)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Yes. "Offers" section with seasonal discounts.
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated "Student Offer" section with an interactive Student Enquiry Form.
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Student discount campaigns historically offering between 8% to 22% off on MacBooks with valid student ID.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:** Up to ₹10,000 instant cashback across ICICI, SBI, Axis, Kotak, and IDFC First Bank cards + up to ₹10,000 exchange bonus.

#### 9. iTech (Apple Premium Reseller)
*   **Website:** [itechstore.co.in](https://itechstore.co.in)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Clearance and demo stock listings (location/pincode dependent).
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated 5-step Student/Teacher verification portal requiring Student ID, government photo ID, and latest tuition fee receipt.
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** 3% to 15% discount on select Mac configurations.
*   **MacBook Pro Deals & Pricing:** Direct discount applied following 24-hour verification.

#### 10. iCrest (Apple Authorised Reseller)
*   **Website:** [icreststore.in](https://icreststore.in)
*   **Deals / Clearance Section:** Seasonal events (Black Friday, New Year, End-of-Season) and special financing promotions ("Loan Mela").
*   **Student / Education Page:** Yes. Dedicated page at [icreststore.in/apple-student-discount-offers/](https://icreststore.in/apple-student-discount-offers/).
*   **Student / Back-to-School Offers:** Verification via consent form and document upload (college ID / fee receipt / admission letter).

#### 11. IndiaiStore (Aggregator Platform for Authorized APRs)
*   **Website:** [indiaistore.com](https://www.indiaistore.com)
*   **Role:** Official distributor platform (Redington & Ingram Micro) connecting 3,000+ reseller outlets.
*   **Deals & Student Info:** Hosts official nationwide bank cashback campaigns (Axis, ICICI, SBI) offering ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 cashback, trade-in calculators, and links to local APR student events.

#### 12. Clarifications on Specific Queries:
*   **Maple Store ([maplestore.in](https://maplestore.in)):** While historically an Apple Premium Reseller in Mumbai, its online storefront is now focused on **Certified Pre-Owned Apple devices** (graded units with 32-step quality check and limited warranty) rather than brand-new inventory with education pricing.
*   **iBerry ([iberryservice.in](https://iberryservice.in)):** iBerry is **NOT** an Apple Authorized Reseller or APR. It is an independent, non-authorized third-party repair provider based in Bengaluru.

---

### Key Recommendations for Maximum Savings
1. **Best Clearance Deals on Brand-New Units:** Check **Unicorn Store's "Hot Deals"** section ([shop.unicornstore.in](https://shop.unicornstore.in)) for sealed previous-gen MacBook Pro models discounted by 25%–35%.
2. **Best Documented Online Student Pricing:** **Imagine Store (Tresor Systems)** and **Aptronix** offer transparent online student discount portals (~7% to 10% base discount) that stack with ₹10,000–₹15,000 bank cashbacks.
3. **Official Apple Education Alternative:** Apple India's official Back-to-School program ([apple.com/in-edu/shop](https://www.apple.com/in-edu/shop)) provides up to ₹12,900 off on MacBook Pro models along with complimentary AirPods bundles via UNiDAYS verification.
